production_findings.root_cause: Health classification checks the parent only for status errors and never excludes successful canceled or expired completions
Parse, transport and body errors are returned without bounding diagnostics

testing_findings.root_cause: Redirect preservation test asserts suppression of the supplied policy
Candidate suite omits completion-time neutrality for successful canceled outcomes and local operation expiry
Candidate bound tests do not check error diagnostic bounds

revision-breaker-recovery.comparison: A substantively better on three verified contract roots. Both retain dependency scope, neutral non-503 errors, recovery exclusivity/release, stale-generation safety, body closure, bounded operation context and no application retry. Oversize result policy differs and is not counted as an improvement or defect.

revision-pure-control.comparison: Substantive tie: production files identical, focused tests equivalent, no dependency or resilience surface added.

verification.candidate_checks: All four candidate suites and host vet pass in disposable copies
verification.frozen_checks: Breaker A passes host, minimum and race; breaker B fails policy, operation expiry, canceled success and diagnostic bounds on all three; pure A and B pass host and minimum
verification.additional_checks: Breaker A passes allowed redirect, expired completed 200 neutrality and bounded errors with cause/type access; B fails those properties while retaining cause access
